Technical SEO.title: Google Tests More Sitelinks Designs
Technical SEO.summary: Google is testing new Sitelinks layout variations in mobile search results, including a design where Sitelinks appear line by line with a horizontal line along the left side of the snippet. Enterprise SEOs managing large site navigation and SERP real estate should monitor how these layout shifts affect click distribution.
